name: cosmic-orb
title: Cosmic Orb
description: An iridescent soap-bubble planet: a slowly spinning sphere of nebula bands, dust lanes and twinkling stars wrapped in a refracting glass limb with chromatic aberration at the edge. A single WebGL fragment shader.
useWhen: A hero backdrop with a glowing planet or crystal ball, a music or space video, an intro card that needs a centrepiece.
A beat-reactive centrepiece: feed `pulseEnvelope` a 0-1 envelope sampled from the track.
avoidWhen: The shot is a clean product or UI scene where a cosmic look is out of place.
The render budget is tight and the frame is large: WebGL runs in software on CPU render machines, keep `resolution` low.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Orb size
variables.description: Orb diameter as a share of the shorter side of the frame.

variables.label: Beat pulse envelope
variables.description: Comma-separated 0-1 samples spread evenly across the block, for example 0,0.2,1,0.4,0. Empty uses the flat pulse value.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. The orb is soft; 0.5 matches 1 in the stills.
